--- title: "Georgia's EPA was positive in every quarter while Missouri spent the game climbing out of an early hole" date: "2026-11-18" description: "Play-by-play EPA shows Georgia adding value in all four quarters while Missouri climbed out of an early hole but never closed the gap. Naming every player on each play, receivers averaged the most EPA per involvement on both teams, and Georgia's players out-averaged Missouri's in every position group." followups: - "Run the log-plus-text player attribution over every 2026 game to build a season EPA leaderboard by player and position group." - "Credit defenders against the expected gain of the play rather than its full EPA, so a tackle that saves a touchdown earns credit instead of blame." - "Build each position group's typical play from every 2026 game, so a team's players are measured against the season rather than only their opponent." - "Fit a fixed-effects model of run EPA with offense, defense and rusher terms to estimate offensive and defensive line unit strength for every 2026 team." - "Weight the passer and receiver EPA split by air yards instead of an even 50/50 share." author: - "AI directed by Nick Giangreco" freeze: auto vignette: > %\VignetteIndexEntry{Georgia's EPA was positive in every quarter while Missouri spent the game climbing out of an early hole} %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html} %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8} --- ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # ---- Packages, data connection and figure defaults ------------------------- # Load the project's functions straight from the checkout with pkgload; the # repo is never installed (decision 0042). The site build sets CFB2NFL_ROOT, # a local render finds the checkout from the working directory. root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT") if (!nzchar(root)) { root <- pkgload::pkg_path() } knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root) pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE) con <- DBI::dbConnect( duckdb::duckdb(), file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"), read_only = TRUE ) library(DBI) library(dplyr) library(duckdb) library(ggiraph) library(ggpath) library(ggplot2) library(ggtext) library(knitr) library(patchwork) library(stringr) library(tidyr) # One interaction style for every girafe figure. set_girafe_defaults( opts_hover = opts_hover( css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);" ), opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"), opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip( css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;" ), opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5), opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"), opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE) ) fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) { formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits) } pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x) # ---- Load the tables ------------------------------------------------------- teams <- dbReadTable(con, "teams") team_colors <- team_color_values(teams) home_team <- "Georgia" away_team <- "Missouri" two_cols <- team_colors[c(home_team, away_team)] names(two_cols) <- c(home_team, away_team) # The game: 2026 week 11, Georgia vs Missouri at Sanford Stadium. g_plays <- dbGetQuery( con, "SELECT * FROM plays WHERE gameId = 401856883 ORDER BY id" ) game_row <- dbGetQuery( con, paste0( "SELECT homeTeam, awayTeam, homePoints, awayPoints, season, week ", "FROM games WHERE id = 401856883" ) ) final_home <- game_row$homePoints final_away <- game_row$awayPoints # ---- Scrimmage plays and expected points ----------------------------------- # A scrimmage play is a run or a pass attempt; kickoffs, punts, field goals, # penalties without a play and period breaks carry no EPA and are excluded. kick_types <- c( "Kickoff", "Kickoff Return (Offense)", "Kickoff Return Touchdown", "Punt", "Punt Return (Offense)", "Punt Return (Defension)", "Punt Return (Defensive)", "Punt Return Touchdown", "Field Goal Good", "Field Goal Missed", "Blocked Field Goal", "Extra Point Good", "Extra Point Missed", "Blocked Extra Point", "Two-Point Pass", "Two-Point Rush", "Two-Point Return", "Uncategorized", "End Period", "Timeout", "Penalty" ) scr <- g_plays |> filter(!playType %in% kick_types) |> arrange(driveNumber, playNumber) |> mutate(seq = row_number()) n_scr <- nrow(scr) n_na_ppa <- sum(is.na(scr$ppa)) # Every EPA in the post is CFBD's ppa. This model exists only for the 3.1 # figure that shows what ppa measures: an expected points curve fit on every # 2026 scrimmage play, whose change across a play tracks ppa. The target is the # net points the offense scored over the rest of the half, anchored on the # home-away score differential so both teams' rows read from one perspective. h26 <- dbGetQuery( con, paste0( "SELECT gameId, driveId, driveNumber, playNumber, period, offense, defense,", " home, away, offenseScore, defenseScore, yardline, yardsToGoal, down,", " distance, yardsGained, playType, playText, ppa", " FROM plays WHERE season = 2026" ) ) |> filter( !playType %in% kick_types, down > 0, !is.na(yardsToGoal), !is.na(distance), !is.na(down) ) |> mutate( half = if_else(period <= 2L, 1L, 2L), home_diff = if_else( offense == home, offenseScore - defenseScore, defenseScore - offenseScore ) ) |> group_by(gameId, half) |> arrange(driveNumber, playNumber, .by_group = TRUE) |> mutate( final_diff = last(home_diff), y_pre = final_diff - home_diff ) |> ungroup() |> mutate(y_off = y_pre * if_else(offense == home, 1L, -1L)) off_td <- c("Rushing Touchdown", "Passing Touchdown") def_td <- c( "Interception Return Touchdown", "Punt Return Touchdown", "Kickoff Return Touchdown", "Fumble Return Touchdown" ) # Scoring plays already carry their points in the row's score; shift the # target back to the pre-play state. A touchdown row shows the six points but # not yet the extra point, so seven folds the expected kick into the target. h26 <- h26 |> mutate( pts_off = case_when( playType %in% off_td ~ 7, playType == "Safety" ~ 2, playType %in% def_td ~ -7, playType == "Field Goal" ~ 3, TRUE ~ 0 ), pts_home = pts_off * if_else(offense == home, 1L, -1L), y_pre = final_diff - (home_diff - pts_home), y_off = y_pre * if_else(offense == home, 1L, -1L) ) library(splines) td_value <- 6.94 ep_fit <- lm( y_off ~ ns(yardsToGoal, df = 8) * factor(down) + ns(distance, df = 4) + factor(down):ns(distance, df = 3), data = h26 ) ep_r2 <- summary(ep_fit)$r.squared # EP before and after each play of the game, and the model's own EPA. ep_from <- function(ytg, dn, dist) { dn <- pmin(pmax(as.integer(dn), 1L), 4L) predict( ep_fit, data.frame( yardsToGoal = max(0, min(99, ytg)), down = dn, distance = dist ) ) } gp3 <- scr |> mutate( td_off = playType %in% off_td, # "Fumble" means the fumble was not lost; a lost fumble is recovered by # the opponent and carries its own play type. turnover = playType == "Pass Interception Return" | playType == "Fumble Recovery (Opponent)", incomplete = playType == "Pass Incompletion", ep_before = ep_from(yardsToGoal, down, distance), ytg2 = yardsToGoal - yardsGained, ep_after = case_when( td_off ~ td_value, turnover ~ -ep_from(100 - yardsToGoal, 1L, 10), incomplete & down < 4 ~ ep_from(yardsToGoal, down + 1L, distance), incomplete ~ -ep_from(100 - yardsToGoal, 1L, 10), ytg2 <= 0 ~ td_value, distance - yardsGained <= 0 ~ ep_from(ytg2, 1L, min(10, ytg2)), down + 1 > 4 ~ -ep_from(100 - ytg2, 1L, 10), .default = ep_from(ytg2, down + 1L, distance - yardsGained) ), epa_mine = ep_after - ep_before ) epa_cor <- cor(gp3$epa_mine, gp3$ppa, use = "complete.obs") # ---- 3.1 Cumulative, per-play and per-drive EPA ---------------------------- # All three panels run on game minutes elapsed, so the two teams share one # time axis and the quarter breaks fall at 15, 30 and 45. cum_ppa <- gp3 |> filter(!is.na(ppa)) |> group_by(offense) |> arrange(seq, .by_group = TRUE) |> mutate( play_n = row_number(), cum_ppa = cumsum(ppa), game_min = (period - 1) * 15 + 15 - (clock_minutes + clock_seconds / 60) ) |> ungroup() # one row per drive with rated plays: the average EPA of its plays, placed # at the midpoint between its first and last snap drive_avg <- cum_ppa |> summarise( plays = n(), avg = mean(ppa), game_min = (min(game_min) + max(game_min)) / 2, period = first(period), seq = max(seq), .by = c(driveId, offense) ) |> arrange(game_min) # second-half EPA per play, and Missouri's longest second-half drive h2_pp <- cum_ppa |> filter(period >= 3) |> summarise(pp = mean(ppa), .by = offense) ga_h2_pp <- h2_pp$pp[h2_pp$offense == home_team] mz_h2_pp <- h2_pp$pp[h2_pp$offense == away_team] mz_long_h2 <- drive_avg |> filter(offense == away_team, period >= 3) |> slice_max(plays, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) tot_epa <- gp3 |> filter(!is.na(ppa)) |> group_by(offense) |> summarise(total = sum(ppa), plays = n(), per_play = mean(ppa)) # ---- 3.2 Quarterly decomposition ------------------------------------------- explosive_threshold <- 1.5 band_exp <- paste0("Explosive play (EPA ", explosive_threshold, "+)") band_ord <- paste0("Ordinary play (EPA 0 to ", explosive_threshold, ")") band_neg <- "Negative play (EPA below 0)" # one row per rated play with its band and the minutes elapsed in its quarter band_plays <- gp3 |> filter(!is.na(ppa)) |> mutate( quarter = paste0("Q", period), band = case_when( ppa >= explosive_threshold ~ band_exp, ppa >= 0 ~ band_ord, .default = band_neg ), minute = 15 - (clock_minutes + clock_seconds / 60) ) qtr_split <- band_plays |> group_by(offense, quarter, band) |> summarise(epa = sum(ppa), n_plays = n(), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(quarter = factor(quarter, paste0("Q", 1:4))) q_share <- qtr_split |> group_by(offense, quarter) |> mutate(q_total = sum(epa)) |> ungroup() # quarterly totals, the cumulative path and the closest Missouri ever got # q_share repeats each quarter's total on every band row, so keep one per # offense and quarter before reading the four-quarter vectors q_tot <- q_share |> distinct(offense, quarter, q_total) |> arrange(offense, quarter) ga_q <- q_tot$q_total[q_tot$offense == home_team] mz_q <- q_tot$q_total[q_tot$offense == away_team] ga_q_min <- min(ga_q) mz_cum_by_q <- cumsum(mz_q) # the deepest point of Missouri's play-by-play running total in 3.1 mz_min_cum <- min(cum_ppa$cum_ppa[cum_ppa$offense == away_team]) mz_cross_q <- paste0("Q", which(mz_cum_by_q > 0)[1]) # the fourth-quarter split for the prose q4_split <- q_share |> filter(offense == away_team, quarter == "Q4") |> select(band, epa, n_plays) mz_q4_exp <- q4_split$epa[q4_split$band == band_exp] mz_q4_ord <- q4_split$epa[q4_split$band == band_ord] mz_q1_neg <- q_share |> filter(offense == away_team, quarter == "Q1", band == band_neg) |> pull(epa) mz_q1_n_exp <- sum( band_plays$offense == away_team & band_plays$quarter == "Q1" & band_plays$band == band_exp ) # ---- 3.3 Drive outcomes ---------------------------------------------------- # One row per drive: the possession team, its starting field position, the # points it scored and its total EPA. The play log files each kickoff under # the receiving team's drive with the kicking team as offense, so the # possession team is read off the drive's scrimmage plays, and points come # from each team's own running score (offenseScore flips with the offense). # Plays sort by drive and play number; the string ids are not in game order. drive_scores <- g_plays |> arrange(driveNumber, playNumber) |> mutate( home_score = if_else(offense == home, offenseScore, defenseScore), away_score = if_else(offense == home, defenseScore, offenseScore) ) |> summarise( home_end = max(home_score), away_end = max(away_score), .by = c(driveId, driveNumber) ) |> arrange(driveNumber) |> mutate( home_start = lag(cummax(home_end), default = 0L), away_start = lag(cummax(away_end), default = 0L) ) possession <- scr |> count(driveId, offense) |> slice_max(n, n = 1, by = driveId, with_ties = FALSE) |> select(driveId, offense) drive_frame <- scr |> semi_join(possession, by = c("driveId", "offense")) |> # kneel-downs carry 0 yards to goal, which no snap can start from filter(yardsToGoal > 0) |> summarise( start_ytg = first(yardsToGoal), .by = c(driveId, driveNumber, offense) ) |> left_join(drive_scores, by = c("driveId", "driveNumber")) |> mutate( points = if_else( offense == home_team, home_end - home_start, away_end - away_start ), outcome = case_when( points >= 6 ~ "Touchdown", points == 3 ~ "Field goal", .default = "No score" ) ) turnover_ends <- gp3 |> filter(turnover) |> group_by(driveId) |> slice_max(seq, n = 1) |> ungroup() |> pull(driveId) drive_epa <- gp3 |> filter(!is.na(ppa)) |> group_by(driveId) |> summarise(drive_epa = sum(ppa), .groups = "drop") to_df <- tibble::tibble(driveId = turnover_ends, to = TRUE) drives <- drive_frame |> left_join(to_df, by = "driveId") |> mutate( outcome = if_else( outcome == "No score" & !is.na(to), "Turnover", outcome ), outcome = factor( outcome, c("Touchdown", "Field goal", "No score", "Turnover") ) ) |> select(-to) |> left_join(drive_epa, by = "driveId") |> arrange(driveNumber) |> mutate(drive_n = row_number()) # drives and touchdowns per team for the 3.3 prose drive_tally <- drives |> summarise( n_drives = n(), n_td = sum(outcome == "Touchdown"), n_nopts = sum(points == 0), .by = offense ) ga_drives <- drive_tally$n_drives[drive_tally$offense == home_team] mz_drives <- drive_tally$n_drives[drive_tally$offense == away_team] ga_tds <- drive_tally$n_td[drive_tally$offense == home_team] mz_tds <- drive_tally$n_td[drive_tally$offense == away_team] ga_nopts <- drive_tally$n_nopts[drive_tally$offense == home_team] mz_nopts <- drive_tally$n_nopts[drive_tally$offense == away_team] # Drive geometry for the field chart: game minutes elapsed at the drive's # first and last snap, and the spot where it ended. Punts, kicks and # turnovers end at the line of scrimmage (a turnover's yards gained include # the return); other plays end where the ball was carried. Kneel-downs carry # 0 yards to goal and give no spot, so a kneel-only drive ends where it began. spot_at_snap <- c( "Punt", "Punt Return", "Field Goal Good", "Field Goal Missed", "Blocked Field Goal", "Penalty", "Pass Interception Return", "Fumble Recovery (Opponent)", "Interception Return Touchdown", "Fumble Return Touchdown" ) drive_geo <- g_plays |> inner_join(select(drives, driveId, poss = offense), by = "driveId") |> filter( offense == poss, !playType %in% c("Kickoff", "Timeout", "End Period", "End of Half", "End of Game") ) |> arrange(driveNumber, playNumber) |> mutate( t = (period - 1) * 15 + 15 - (clock_minutes + clock_seconds / 60), spot = case_when( yardsToGoal == 0 ~ NA_real_, playType %in% off_td ~ 0, playType %in% spot_at_snap ~ yardsToGoal, .default = pmax(yardsToGoal - yardsGained, 1) ) ) |> summarise( t0 = first(t), t1 = last(t), end_ytg = last(na.omit(spot)), .by = driveId ) # Georgia defends the left end zone and attacks right, Missouri the reverse; # x is yards from Georgia's goal line. drive_arrows <- drives |> left_join(drive_geo, by = "driveId") |> mutate( end_ytg = coalesce(end_ytg, start_ytg), x0 = if_else(offense == home_team, 100 - start_ytg, start_ytg), x1 = if_else(offense == home_team, 100 - end_ytg, end_ytg), # the change of possession links this drive's end to the next one's start x_next = lead(x0), t_next = lead(t0) ) out_palette <- c( "Touchdown" = "#3ee06b", "Field goal" = "#fde047", "No score" = "#d1d5db", "Turnover" = "#ff5a5a" ) n_ga_td <- sum(drives$outcome == "Touchdown" & drives$offense == home_team) n_mz_td <- sum(drives$outcome == "Touchdown" & drives$offense == away_team) # ---- 3.4 and 3.5 Player involvement ---------------------------------------- # The play-stats log names the passer, rusher and target on each play but # few defenders; the play-by-play text also lists the tacklers, so a text # mention adds any player the log leaves out. Mentions resolve to athlete ids # by jersey and surname against the 2026 rosters (named from the season stat # lines). Each play's EPA is split evenly among the players named on each # side, so a team's offensive shares add up to its EPA. game_log <- dbGetQuery( con, paste0( "SELECT playId, athleteId, athleteName, team, statType FROM play_stats ", "WHERE gameId = 401856883" ) ) directory <- dbGetQuery( con, " SELECT r.playerId, r.team, r.jersey, r.position, s.player FROM roster r JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT playerId, team, player FROM player_stats WHERE season = 2026) s ON s.playerId = r.playerId AND s.team = r.team WHERE r.season = 2026 AND r.team IN ('Georgia', 'Missouri')" ) rated <- filter(gp3, !is.na(ppa)) mentions <- play_text_mentions(rated) |> match_play_mentions(directory) n_unresolved <- sum(is.na(mentions$playerId)) log_names <- distinct(game_log, playerId = athleteId, log_name = athleteName) inv <- build_play_involvement(rated, game_log, mentions) |> left_join( distinct(directory, playerId, player, position, jersey), by = "playerId" ) |> left_join(log_names, by = "playerId") |> left_join( select(rated, id, seq, period, playText, yardsGained), by = "id" ) |> mutate( player = coalesce(player, log_name), group = harmonize_position(position, "roster"), # the figure label, "#14 Gunner Stockton, QB", and the same label in the # team's color for the markdown axis text label = paste0( if_else(is.na(jersey), "", paste0("#", jersey, " ")), player, if_else(is.na(position), "", paste0(", ", position)) ), axis_lab = paste0( "", label, "" ) ) n_inv <- nrow(inv) # the play where the 3.1 model and CFBD's PPA disagree most gap_play <- rated |> slice_max(abs(epa_mine - ppa), n = 1) n_plays_off <- n_distinct(inv$id[inv$side == "Offense"]) n_plays_def <- n_distinct(inv$id[inv$side == "Defense"]) inv_sources <- inv |> summarise( involvements = n(), players = n_distinct(playerId), .by = c(source, side) ) n_text_def <- sum(inv$source == "Play text" & inv$side == "Defense") n_log_def <- sum(inv$source == "Play-stats log" & inv$side == "Defense") n_text_tackles <- sum(inv$source == "Play text" & inv$roles == "Tackle") # Jalen Marshall, the tackler the log never names marshall <- inv |> filter(player == "Jalen Marshall") # One row per player: EPA contributed (the sum of their shares), how often # they were named, the average EPA of those plays from their side, and how # many of the quarters they played in their credit was positive. players <- inv |> summarise( team = first(team), group = first(group), involvements = n(), epa = sum(share), per_inv = mean(epa_side), q_played = n_distinct(period), q_pos = sum(tapply(share, period, sum) > 0), .by = c(playerId, player, label, axis_lab) ) |> arrange(desc(epa)) # 3.5 ranks players by average EPA per involvement, so a player named once # cannot top the board on one big play: only players named at least min_inv # times are ranked. min_inv <- 4L regulars <- players |> filter(involvements >= min_inv) |> arrange(per_inv) top_by_team <- regulars |> slice_max(per_inv, n = 1, by = team) top <- top_by_team |> slice_max(per_inv, n = 1) ga_top <- top_by_team[top_by_team$team == home_team, ] mz_top <- top_by_team[top_by_team$team == away_team, ] qbs_lead <- all(top_by_team$group == "Quarterback") # the volume leader: most EPA contributed in total vol_top <- players[1, ] vol_top_rank <- match(vol_top$playerId, rev(regulars$playerId)) # Position groups. Each group is named on a different kind of play (a # defensive lineman near the line, a defensive back at the end of a gain), so # each is measured against its own typical play: the average EPA per # involvement over both teams. The offensive line is left out: the text names # a lineman only on a tackle after a turnover, never for blocking. group_plural <- c( "Quarterback" = "quarterbacks", "Running back" = "running backs", "Receiver" = "receivers", "Tight end" = "tight ends", "Offensive line" = "offensive linemen", "Defensive line" = "defensive linemen", "Linebacker" = "linebackers", "Defensive back" = "defensive backs", "Special teams" = "special teams players", "Position not recorded" = "players with no listed position" ) n_ol_inv <- sum(inv$group == "Offensive line") group_order <- intersect( harmonized_position_levels(), setdiff(unique(inv$group), "Offensive line") ) inv_groups <- inv |> filter(group %in% group_order) |> mutate( group = factor(group, levels = group_order), typical = mean(epa_side), .by = group ) groups <- inv_groups |> summarise( involvements = n(), typical = first(typical), yards = mean(yardsGained), .by = group ) |> arrange(group) groups_team <- inv_groups |> summarise( involvements = n(), per_inv = mean(epa_side), median = median(epa_side), epa = sum(share), typical = first(typical), .by = c(group, team) ) |> mutate(vs_typical = per_inv - typical) n_groups <- length(group_order) ga_vs <- groups_team |> filter(team == home_team) # head to head: groups where Georgia's players out-averaged Missouri's h2h <- groups_team |> select(group, team, per_inv) |> pivot_wider(names_from = team, values_from = per_inv) n_ga_ahead <- sum(h2h[[home_team]] > h2h[[away_team]]) ga_vs_min <- min(ga_vs$vs_typical) ga_vs_max <- max(ga_vs$vs_typical) db_team <- groups_team |> filter(group == "Defensive back") db_typical <- groups$typical[groups$group == "Defensive back"] db_yards <- groups$yards[groups$group == "Defensive back"] front_yards <- mean( inv$yardsGained[ inv$side == "Defense" & inv$group %in% c("Defensive line", "Linebacker") ] ) # ---- inline numbers for the prose ------------------------------------------ # the closest Missouri came, play by play, once its running total first # went positive run_gap <- cum_ppa |> arrange(seq) |> mutate( ga_run = cumsum(if_else(offense == home_team, ppa, 0)), mz_run = cumsum(if_else(offense == away_team, ppa, 0)), gap = ga_run - mz_run ) cross_seq <- run_gap$seq[which(run_gap$mz_run > 0)[1]] min_gap_post <- min(run_gap$gap[run_gap$seq >= cross_seq]) # the quarter of Missouri's lowest running total mz_min_q <- c("first", "second", "third", "fourth")[ cum_ppa$period[cum_ppa$offense == away_team][ which.min(cum_ppa$cum_ppa[cum_ppa$offense == away_team]) ] ] ``` ::: ::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"} *Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-11-18. Every number in this post is computed from the published database, and every EPA is the play-level PPA that CFBD publishes; a model fit on all 190,135 2026 scrimmage plays appears in 3.1 only to show what PPA measures.* ::: ## 1. Introduction Expected points (EP) is the number of points the offense is expected to net over the rest of the half given down, distance and field position. Expected points added (EPA) is the difference between the EP after a play and the EP before it, so one play's outcome becomes one number in points; the EPA used throughout is the value CFBD publishes for every play, which it calls predicted points added (PPA). Reading Georgia 48, Missouri 21, the week 11 meeting at Sanford Stadium, play by play, turns the final score into a sequence of value that shows who controlled the game and when it was decided. + *Georgia's cumulative EPA rose in every quarter.* + *Missouri's cumulative EPA stayed below zero until the third quarter and never closed the gap.* + *Georgia's players out-average Missouri's in every position group.* + *Each team's quarterback averages the most EPA per involvement of any player on the team.* ## 2. Data ### 2.1 Every number in the post is built on a play's change in expected points ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tibble::tribble( ~Term , ~Meaning , "Scrimmage play" , "A run or pass attempt. Kickoffs, punts, kicks and breaks carry no EPA." , "Expected points (EP)" , "Points the offense is expected to net over the rest of the half, from down, distance and field position." , "EPA (PPA)" , "Points gained by the offense on one play: EP after minus EP before. Every EPA here is the predicted points added (PPA) that CFBD publishes for the play." , "Cumulative EPA" , "The running sum of a team's EPA over its own plays, in game order." , "Drive EPA per play" , "The average EPA of a drive's plays, one value per drive." , "Drive" , "One possession, from takeover to points, punt, turnover or half's end." , "Explosive play" , paste0("A play worth at least ", explosive_threshold, " EPA.") , "Involvement" , "A player named on a play: passer, rusher, target, tackler, or a defender who broke up a pass, forced a fumble or intercepted it." , "EPA contributed" , "A play's EPA split evenly among the players named on each side, positive for the offense and reversed for the defense, then summed over the game." , "EPA per involvement" , "The average EPA, from the player's own side, of the plays the player was named on." , "Position group" , "The roster position grouped: quarterback, running back, receiver, tight end, offensive line, defensive line, linebacker, defensive back." , "Typical play" , "A position group's average EPA per involvement over both teams, the baseline each team's players are measured against." ) |> kable(caption = "Terms used throughout, in plain language.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Terms used throughout, in plain language. |Term |Meaning | |:--------------------|:--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| |Scrimmage play |A run or pass attempt. Kickoffs, punts, kicks and breaks carry no EPA. | |Expected points (EP) |Points the offense is expected to net over the rest of the half, from down, distance and field position. | |EPA (PPA) |Points gained by the offense on one play: EP after minus EP before. Discussion ::: {.callout-important} The bottom panel of 3.1 separates *who moved the ball* from *who scored*: Missouri strung together long drives after halftime, its longest a 13-play drive at 0.50 EPA per play, but Georgia's second-half plays averaged 0.57 EPA against Missouri's 0.24, so the gap Georgia built in the first quarter never closed. - Crediting a play's EPA to everyone named on it measures involvement, not blame: a defensive back who makes the tackle at the end of a long gain takes that gain's negative EPA, while a defender who ends a run at the line earns credit. Comparing each group with its own typical play takes that out: Georgia's defensive backs averaged -0.48 EPA per involvement, negative but above their group's -0.61, while Missouri's averaged -0.73. - How much a group's plays vary is shown but not judged: a wide spread can mean big plays both ways, and whether that is good depends on the group. ::: Caveats: every EPA is CFBD's PPA, so the post inherits whatever its model leaves out; the spline curve in 3.1, which reads only down, distance and field position, is there to show what PPA measures and is not used anywhere else. A single game rests on 119 scrimmage plays with an EPA. Player credit splits each play evenly among the players named on it, so a passer and receiver share a completion equally, and the 19 plays that name no defender, mostly incompletions and touchdowns, give the defense no credit at all. The text names an offensive lineman only when one makes a tackle after a turnover, 1 time in this game, so the line stays nearly invisible to play-level attribution. The typical play in 3.4 is the two teams' combined average, so the comparison is head to head; a typical play drawn from every 2026 game would give an outside baseline. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE) ``` :::
